# WORKFLOW LEARNING ROUND TEMPLATE

Use this template after any meaningful implementation / visual QA / authoring / runtime slice.

Purpose: capture what happened, what evidence proved it, what was attempted, and whether the lesson is reusable. Do not promote an idea to a permanent rule until it has actually improved the workflow.

```text
ROUND / SLICE:

TARGET:

DONOR / BASELINE:

PROBLEM OBSERVED:

EVIDENCE:

ROOT CAUSE:

CHANGE ATTEMPTED:

RESULT:

STATUS:

[ ] HYPOTHESIS

[ ] WORKED ONCE

[ ] VALIDATED PATTERN

[ ] REJECTED / NO IMPROVEMENT

REUSABLE RULE:

WHERE ELSE TO TRY IT:

WHAT MUST NOT BE GENERALIZED YET:
```

## Usage rule

A workflow improvement follows this lifecycle:

```text
HYPOTHESIS
  ↓
BOUNDED EXPERIMENT
  ↓
EVIDENCE / COMPARISON
  ↓
WORKED ONCE
  ↓ repeat where appropriate
VALIDATED PATTERN  OR  REJECTED / NO IMPROVEMENT
  ↓
DOCUMENT + REUSE
```

Keep failed experiments too. A rejected path is useful knowledge when it prevents another project or agent from repeating the same expensive mistake.
